manual_actions.description: The agent API exists (CreateAgent) but the deployment keeps it manual: the agent must be bound to the topic, the contracts space and the three MCP tools in the console, and it needs a Professional licence per account manager. Chapter 22 rates this risk as 'strong probability, low impact'.
manual_actions.reference: docs/SPEC.fr.md chapter 22, risk 'Agents, flows and spaces are not creatable by program'
steps: Open the Quick console, then Agents, then Create agent.
Name it 'Profitability analyst' and paste the instructions of the agent section of the bundle (agent.instructions and agent.rules).
Attach the knowledge: the topic marge_topic and the contracts space marge_project.
Attach the three MCP actions create_renegotiation_task, draft_extra_billing_proposal and get_margin_breakdown.
Add the five reference questions of agent.examples as the test set of the agent.
Publish the agent and give it the Professional licence of the account managers.

manual_actions.description: A scheduled flow belongs to the user who creates it (spec 14.4), so it is created by the controller in the console. The flow API (CreateFlow) cannot transfer ownership.
steps: Sign in as the controller, open Flows, then Create scheduled flow.
Name it 'Monthly profitability review' and paste the six steps of flow.steps.
Set the schedule to the third working day of the month, at 07:00 UTC.
Add the sources: the dashboards EF-TDB-01, EF-TDB-03, EF-TDB-04 and the topic.
Add the destinations: the e-mail of the direction and the project space marge_project.
Run it once on a past month and check the figures against the dashboards.

manual_actions.description: The contracts space holds the PDF contracts of the clients and is the knowledge source the agent quotes from. It is created in the console so that its memberships stay under the control of the administrator.
steps: Open Spaces, then Create space, and name it marge_project.
Add the S3 bucket of the contracts as a knowledge source, read only.
Give access to the agent and to the controller, and to nobody else.
Check on a contract that the agent quotes the clause with its article number.

manual_actions.description: When the account does not expose the topic API, the semantic layer is declared in the console from the topic section of the bundle.
manual_actions.reference: docs/SPEC.fr.md chapter 14.1 and point 9 of chapter 24
manual_actions.resource: Semantic layer, fallback if the API is not exposed
steps: Open the Quick console, then the topic marge_topic.
Declare the twelve metrics of topic.metrics with their definition and their unit.
Declare the synonyms of topic.synonyms so that 'rentabilite', 'marge', 'profit' and 'margin' all resolve to the margin metric.
Declare the five joins of topic.joins between the datasets.
Check that the default aggregations of topic.default_aggregations are the ones of the specification.

programmable_steps.description: Athena data source pointing at the curated S3 zone.
one client, one month — Monthly margin of each client: revenue by post, cost by nature, margin, rate, coverage.

parameters.name: marge_client_mois
parameters.sql:
WITH marge AS (
    SELECT
        client_id,
        month,
        revenue_subscription,
        revenue_aws_resale,
        revenue_extra_hours_billed,
        revenue_projects,
        cost_labour,
        cost_tooling,
        cost_msp_aws,
        cost_penalties,
        margin,
        margin_rate,
        coverage,
        is_estimate,
        state,
        calc_version
    FROM marge.marge_mensuelle
)
SELECT
    m.client_id,
    c.client_name,
    c.account_manager_id,
    m.month,
    m.revenue_subscription,
    m.revenue_aws_resale,
    m.revenue_extra_hours_billed,
    m.revenue_projects,
    m.revenue_subscription + m.revenue_aws_resale
        + m.revenue_extra_hours_billed + m.revenue_projects AS revenue_total,
    m.cost_labour,
    m.cost_tooling,
    m.cost_msp_aws,
    m.cost_penalties,
    m.cost_labour + m.cost_tooling + m.cost_msp_aws + m.cost_penalties AS cost_total,
    m.margin,
    m.margin_rate,
    m.coverage,
    m.is_estimate,
    m.state,
    m.calc_version
FROM marge m
JOIN marge.clients c ON c.client_id = m.client_id

programmable_steps.description: one client, one month, one work category, one level — Effort and labour cost split by category and by level, with the class of the work.

parameters.name: effort_client_mois_categorie
parameters.sql:
WITH classed AS (
    SELECT
        i.client_id,
        i.occurred_on,
        i.category,
        i.level,
        i.ticket_id,
        i.hours_spent,
        COALESCE(cl.work_class, 'IN_SCOPE') AS work_class
    FROM marge.interventions i
    LEFT JOIN marge.classements cl ON cl.intervention_id = i.intervention_id
),
rated AS (
    SELECT
        k.*,
        r.hourly_cost,
        k.hours_spent * r.hourly_cost AS labour_cost
    FROM classed k
    JOIN marge.couts_horaires r
      ON r.level = k.level
     AND r.effective_from <= LAST_DAY(CAST(k.occurred_on AS DATE))
     AND r.effective_from = (
            SELECT MAX(r2.effective_from)
            FROM marge.couts_horaires r2
            WHERE r2.level = k.level
              AND r2.effective_from <= LAST_DAY(CAST(k.occurred_on AS DATE))
        )
)
SELECT
    rated.client_id,
    clients.account_manager_id,
    DATE_FORMAT(CAST(rated.occurred_on AS DATE), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    rated.category,
    rated.level,
    SUM(rated.hours_spent) AS hours_spent,
    SUM(rated.labour_cost) AS labour_cost,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rated.ticket_id) AS ticket_count,
    ANY_VALUE(rated.work_class) AS work_class,
    ANY_VALUE(rated.hourly_cost) AS hourly_cost
FROM rated
JOIN marge.clients clients ON clients.client_id = rated.client_id
GROUP BY
    rated.client_id,
    clients.account_manager_id,
    DATE_FORMAT(CAST(rated.occurred_on AS DATE), 'yyyy-MM'),
    rated.category,
    rated.level

programmable_steps.description: one client, one month — Unbilled hours per client and month, with their value and their state.

parameters.name: heures_non_facturees
parameters.sql:
SELECT
    h.client_id,
    c.account_manager_id,
    h.month,
    h.out_of_scope_validated_hours,
    h.over_quota_hours,
    h.billed_extra_hours,
    h.out_of_scope_validated_hours + h.over_quota_hours - h.billed_extra_hours AS unbilled_hours,
    h.contract_hour_rate,
    (h.out_of_scope_validated_hours + h.over_quota_hours - h.billed_extra_hours)
        * h.contract_hour_rate AS unbilled_value,
    h.state
FROM marge.heures_non_facturees h
JOIN marge.clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id

programmable_steps.description: one contract — Contracts renewing within 90 days, with the six-month margin rate and the trend.

parameters.name: contrats_actifs
parameters.sql:
WITH marge_6m AS (
    SELECT
        client_id,
        SUM(revenue_subscription + revenue_aws_resale
            + revenue_extra_hours_billed + revenue_projects) AS revenue_6m,
        SUM(cost_labour + cost_tooling + cost_msp_aws + cost_penalties) AS cost_6m
    FROM marge.marge_mensuelle
    WHERE month >= date_format(current_date, 'yyyy-MM')
              - INTERVAL '5' MONTH
    GROUP BY client_id
),
trend AS (
    SELECT
        client_id,
        CASE
            WHEN margin_rate - LAG(margin_rate) OVER (
                     PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY month) >  0.005 THEN 'UP'
            WHEN margin_rate - LAG(margin_rate) OVER (
                     PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY month) < -0.005 THEN 'DOWN'
            ELSE 'FLAT'
        END AS trend
    FROM marge.marge_mensuelle
)
SELECT
    ct.contract_id,
    ct.version,
    ct.client_id,
    c.client_name,
    c.account_manager_id,
    ct.monthly_subscription,
    ct.included_hours_per_month,
    ct.extra_hour_rate,
    ct.end_date,
    DATE_DIFF('day', current_date, ct.end_date) AS days_to_renewal,
    CASE WHEN m.revenue_6m > 0
         THEN (m.revenue_6m - m.cost_6m) / m.revenue_6m
         ELSE 0 END AS margin_rate_six_months,
    COALESCE(t.trend, 'FLAT') AS trend,
    ct.status
FROM marge.contrats ct
JOIN marge.clients c ON c.client_id = ct.client_id
LEFT JOIN marge_6m m ON m.client_id = ct.client_id
LEFT JOIN trend t ON t.client_id = ct.client_id
WHERE ct.status IN ('VALIDATED', 'AMENDED')
  AND ct.end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE_DIFF('day', current_date, ct.end_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 90

programmable_steps.description: one intervention — Classifications awaiting a human decision, with the cited contract clause.

parameters.name: interventions_a_valider
parameters.sql:
SELECT
    i.intervention_id,
    i.ticket_id,
    i.client_id,
    c.client_name,
    c.account_manager_id,
    i.occurred_on,
    i.category,
    i.level,
    i.hours_spent,
    cl.work_class AS proposed_class,
    cl.confidence,
    cl.cited_clause,
    cl.reason,
    cl.needs_human_validation,
    cl.status AS decision_status
FROM marge.classements cl
JOIN marge.interventions i ON i.intervention_id = cl.intervention_id
JOIN marge.clients c ON c.client_id = i.client_id
WHERE cl.status = 'PENDING'
  AND cl.work_class IN ('OUT_OF_SCOPE', 'UNCERTAIN')

programmable_steps.description: Semantic layer of Marge: the definitions of the margin, of the effort and of the unbilled hours, the business synonyms, the default aggregations and the joins between the five analytical datasets. Every question about the profitability of a client goes through this topic so that two people get the same number.
Total margin of the period, ranking of the clients, clients under the threshold and the month-over-month trend, with the coverage indicator.
Revenue, cost by nature, hours by level and by category, contract quota and commercial terms of one client.
Unbilled hours by client, in hours and in value, with their state and the classifications waiting for a human.
Contracts renewing within 90 days, with their margin rate and their trend.
Work types that cost the most, by client, by category and by level.
The same analytical tables, restricted by the row-level rule to the clients of the signed-in account manager.
Rows are kept when the account_manager_id column equals the session parameter. Roles listed with ALL see every row.
